caption_L1: This bar chart is called Number of the coronavirus (COVID-19) cases across Indian states and union territories as of December 17 , 2020 , by type. Along the x-axis, Deceased is defined along a linear scale from 0 to 50,000. state of India is drawn along a categorical scale starting with Andaman and Nicobar Islands and ending with West Bengal along the y-axis.
caption_L2L3: Maharashtra suffered a tremendous amount of losses as compared to the other areas. Some areas, such as Nagaland, Sikkim, and Arunachal Pradesh seemed to have no or a very small number of losses. Only three areas had greater than 10,000 deceased.
